$comment: The template's placeholder vocabulary — one registry, three consumers. scripts/build_state_template.py emits every {{TOKEN}} listed here (and nothing else: an emitted token missing from this file, or a listed token missing from the emitted tree, both fail the build). scripts/bootstrap_state.py fills every token and sentinel. scripts/check_template_placeholders.py (shipped in the template) fails the new fork's CI while any token or sentinel survives. Tokens are for free-text files (HTML/JS/YAML comments and strings); sentinels are schema-valid stand-in VALUES for JSON files whose patterns would reject {{...}} — both are listed so the checker flags them all.

BRAND_NAME.description: The fork's product name, used in the masthead, titles and social cards

CANONICAL_URL.description: Canonical site URL with scheme and trailing slash

EXPORTS_NAME.description: The window debug-namespace identifier (^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$), twinned between index.html and smoke_test.mjs

GOATCOUNTER_URL.description: The fork's own GoatCounter count endpoint — EXPANSION_GUIDE §4.4.1 item 14: trackEvent no-ops silently without one

FAVICON_DATA_URI.description: Inline SVG favicon as a data: URI
FAVICON_DATA_URI.example: data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Ccircle cx='32' cy='32' r='30' fill='%234A90D9'/%3E%3C/svg%3E

PALETTE_ACCENT_DEEP.description: Deep accent hex for text/links on light bg

GEOCODER_BIAS_LAT.description: Photon type-ahead bias latitude — the state's population centre, 2 decimals

PORTAL_HOST.description: The fork's primary open-data portal host (bare hostname), used by the smoke test's failure-isolation kill; a fork with no portal keeps a .invalid host and the kill test stays inert

EMPTY_STATE_LEDE.description: One orientation sentence under the empty-state prompt naming what a reader will see
EMPTY_STATE_LEDE.example: See your county, township, municipality, school district, and U.S. House district — plus who represents you.
